mapper.select: SELECT permission_code FROM sys_permission WHERE #{path} LIKE REPLACE(url_pattern, '*', '%') AND (http_method = #{method} OR http_method = '*') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(url_pattern) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS permission_id FROM askops_schema.sys_permission p INNER JOIN askops_schema.role_permission_mapping rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN askops_schema.user_role_mapping ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
